why_commits_can_have_zero_files: GitHub lists the net diff of the PR head against the base, not the sum of each commit. Squash-merging the same work onto the base, or committing a change and its revert, leaves commits whose combined tree matches the base. The PR then shows commits and zero changed files. There is no remaining blob to recover.
